question: What is the cash position and runway?

beats.line: At the end of September, Diginex held one point eight five million dollars in cash.
beats.headline: $1.85M
beats.action: [0-5s] A halftone stack of paper coins drops onto a cream chip and settles. [5-10s] The camera holds as the stack tilts slightly and steadies.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] At the end of September, Diginex held one point eight five million dollars in cash.

beats.line: Six months earlier it was three point one one million.
beats.headline: $3.11M → $1.85M
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip slides off the top edge as the coin stack loses coin after coin. [5-10s] Cut to a torn-paper arrow entering low and pointing down beside the shrunken stack.
beats.delivery: Six months earlier it was three point one one million.

beats.line: Operating cash burn ran three point nine million over those six months.
beats.headline: $3.9M BURN
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip flips away as the torn-paper arrow unrolls into a paper calendar strip. [5-10s] Coins slide off the strip one by one and drop out of frame.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] Operating cash burn ran three point nine million over those six months.

beats.line: That works out at about one point three million dollars a month.
beats.headline: $1.3M / MONTH
beats.action: [0-5s] The old chip is covered as a paper hand enters and taps the calendar strip month by month. [5-10s] The hand drags the strip sideways until only a short torn piece remains.
beats.delivery: That works out at about one point three million dollars a month.

beats.line: At that rate, the cash on hand covers one point four months of runway.
beats.headline: 1.4 MONTHS
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip drops away as the torn strip widens into a paper runway cut short. [5-10s] A cutout aircraft rolls forward and stops hard at the torn end.
beats.delivery: [excited] At that rate, the cash on hand covers one point four months of runway.

beats.line: Warrant exercises raised eleven point four million, which kept the company afloat.
beats.headline: +$11.4M
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip slides off as the torn runway folds up into a paper document. [5-10s] Cut in close as fresh paper coins are laid across the document in a row.
beats.delivery: Warrant exercises raised eleven point four million, which kept the company afloat.

beats.line: Then October's warrant exercise generated another thirteen point eight million dollars.
beats.headline: +$13.8M
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip flips down as the paper document unfolds wider and more coins land on it. [5-10s] Tape pieces press across the coins, fixing them in place.
beats.delivery: Then October's warrant exercise generated another thirteen point eight million dollars.

beats.line: Survival hinges on continued access to capital markets. The company is not yet self-sustaining.
beats.headline: NOT SELF-SUSTAINING
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip slides away as the paper document folds into a paper building and the coin stack returns beside it. [5-10s] Cut wider; the building leans on the stack and holds.
beats.delivery: Survival hinges on continued access to capital markets. The company is not yet self-sustaining.

beats.line: The next six to nine months are critical for Diginex.
beats.headline: 6–9 MONTHS
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip flips off as the coin stack settles back onto a cream chip. [5-10s] A paper hand enters and rests one final coin on top of the stack.
beats.delivery: The next six to nine months are critical for Diginex.
